scope: Diagnostic profiling and exploratory isolated kernels; not headline request throughput
command: nsys profile --trace=cuda,nvtx --sample=none --cuda-graph-trace=node [--cuda-event-trace=false for V1] --force-overwrite=true -o TRACE PROBE MODEL PROMPT 32

profiles.name: v1-2b
profiles.source_notes: Uncommitted V1 production implementation, before adding the new test fixture. The production kernel and dispatch match commit 511f09584e79d7ac16e974604de4ab9c0ed1ae57; this is exploratory profiling, not the final benchmark binary.

experiment_notes: Standalone NVCC -O3 --fmad=false -arch=sm_86; application uses NVRTC compute_80. Synthetic weights/activations, not complete model requests.
multirow mode 10 is two rows/warp; mode 11 is four. These float variants were selected. All recorded diff fields are zero output-bit differences.

Repacked weights and the three integer-drafter prototypes were rejected. The integer prototypes include quantization cost; they are not a reproduction of the port's optimized transposed integer kernel.

Nsight Compute on a synthetic scalar float specialization measured 93.17% L1/TEX throughput, 12.88% DRAM throughput, 95.66% L1 hit rate, 89.68% compute throughput, and no local-memory spill. It identifies L1/issue pressure on that kernel, not a full-application bandwidth claim.
